strictISOCase.nonvacuity: Assert actual anchor count9, nonempty iso strings and both governance/default records are present before evaluating their id/label pairs. Collect actual findings before the final strict assertions so the emitted CIT002 records remain retained even while the criterion fails.
strictISOCase.semanticObservation: Parse each actual iso string at the existing display separator into ID and label. Identify A.5/A.5.* policy labels from actual object records and retain their exact array indices/values. This simple semantic assertion is independent of the collector helper so deleting a finding cannot hide the bad emitted data.
strictISOCase.collectorObservation: Retain actual CIT002 entries from src/domains/industryPackAudit.ts that name the forbidden A.5 policy pair, with file/location/message/zeroTolerance fields. Record other findings and baseline debt separately; do not broaden assertion to all ratcheted catalogue debt.
strictISOCase.strictAssertions: Forbidden actual source-pair rows must equal[] and forbidden collector findings must equal[]. Both currently have two known source-backed entries, so the single strict case is anticipatedRED until the expert/owner resolves content. No runtime RED is claimed yet.
strictISOCase.expertBoundary: Row17 requires a licensed ISO expert choice, and the official ISO table remains empty. This test does not invent the replacement clause or edit the reserved audit producer.
